data.long_meaning: The name Aaween is derived from the Arabic word 'Awwan', which means 'to be joyful, delighted, or to bring happiness'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Islamic culture. The name Aaween carries the meaning “Joyful, Delightful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aaween usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, delightful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
